notes: Emsisoft deploy: rides through Emsisoft's slow server. The install-token and workspace-lookup calls now allow up to 55s and retry once automatically when Emsisoft times out, and if links still don't come back there's a 'Try fetching links again' button that re-pulls them for the SAME workspace — no new workspace and no licence used. The existing-workspace check is also more reliable now. When Emsisoft's own servers are overloaded (504 / gateway timeout) the workspace and the links may simply need a retry a minute later.
